Name: mothbeanie's Gift Taste Redone for 1.6
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=3]This is an update of mothbeanie's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10660]Gift Taste Redone[/url], which now only requires Content Patcher instead of the obsolete Custom Gift Dialogue Utility. As mothbeanie has open permissions, I have uploaded it here, but if you enjoy this mod, please make sure to endorse the original and leave a comment for mothbeanie!

It has also been updated to use i18n. For translators, you may translate this as long as credit is given to mothbeanie as the original author and only the translated i18n file is uploaded.

Description from the original mod:

-------------------------------------

This mod tweaks the gift tastes for most NPCs. Many minerals and artifacts now have people who like them as gifts, and a couple items which were inexplicably universally hated or disliked have had their universal opinion changed and/or now have people who actually like them.

See the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10660?tab=articles]Articles [/url]tab for gift spoilers.

[u]Compatibility:[/u]

This mod patches Caroline's dislikes by overwriting them, and thus may be incompatible with other mods that do the same. This can be disabled in the config.
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8118]Custom Gift Responses[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url].

[u]Config:[/u]

[b]CarolineNeutralMayo: [/b][i]true[/i] to remove mayonnaise and duck mayonnaise from Caroline's dislikes and to add them to her neutral gifts, [i]false [/i]for no change (default: [i]true[/i])
[/size]
